intro.text: The apostrophe (') sits beside the semicolon – reach with your right little finger. Quotation marks (") need Shift too: on a UK keyboard they are on the 2 key; on a US keyboard they share the apostrophe key.
intro.tip: Watch the on-screen keyboard to see where the quotation mark lives on your layout.

steps.title: Meet apostrophe and quotation mark
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. The cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.instructions: Reach for the new keys, then return to the home row.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: New keys mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: "It's a lovely day," said Ava. "Let's go to the park." I'm sure we'll have fun. Don't forget your hat.
"It is only me," said Gran. We're glad she's here. It's Sam's turn next.
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out – trust your fingers!
